en-GB.shortDescription: Copy, share & set reminders for your favourite quotes.
en-GB.fullDescription: Here's everything you can do on Quoter: - Set notifications - Read aloud a quote in your favourite language voice - Copy quote text - Share quote as image - Customize notification type: Get text only quotes or image styled quotes as notifications - Switch between light theme & dark theme 🔔 Get notified Set notifications at your suitable time and receive quotes straight to your device. Fire & Forget! 🗣️ Listen a quote You can tap on the speaker icon to read aloud a quote. You can also customize the voice of the spoken language in settings. 👥 Copy & Share quotes Get the conversation going by copying and/or sharing your favourite quotes with your loved ones. More features are under development! For feature requests, leave a review or hit me up at: adhikaridayamoy@gmail.com Enough said! ;)
en-GB.title: Quotes app | Quoter
